note: Rewritten from the species-level description of Chhotani (1997), originally in English; alates recorded as unknown in the original, with only soldiers and workers described; synonymy, literature citations, figure numbers and distribution records not translated.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule yellow to deep rusty brown, antennae uniformly pale yellow, labrum pale yellowish brown, mandibles reddish brown, thorax and abdomen creamy yellow. Cephalic setae sparse, body setae dense. Body length 4.5–6.00 mm. Head capsule oval, slightly longer than wide (head length to mandibular base 1.30–1.53, maximum width 1.15–1.33, width at mandibular base 0.68–0.85 mm; maximum width/length index 0.85–0.98, mandibular base width/maximum width index 0.59–0.66). Antennae 15–16-segmented; with 15 segments segment 3 shortest and segment 4 slightly longer than segment 3, with 16 segments segment 2 as long as segments 3 and 4 together and segment 4 shortest. Mandibles short, thick and stout, distinctly shorter than the head (length 0.73–0.80 mm, left mandible length/head length index 0.52–0.60); left mandible with a sharp tooth at the apical third (tooth/mandible length index 0.31–0.35), right mandible with a small vestigial tooth slightly below the level of the left mandibular tooth. Postmentum inflated and arched at the middle (length 0.75–0.88, maximum width 0.53–0.63 mm, width/length index 0.68–0.78). Pronotum saddle-shaped, anterior lobe triangular with a deep median concavity; posterior margin weakly to distinctly concave. Mesonotum slightly narrower, metanotum slightly wider than pronotum, posterior margins of both nearly straight.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Worker monomorphic. Head capsule yellowish brown to pale brown, antennae uniformly yellow, labrum, postclypeus and body yellow. Cephalic setae rather dense, body setae rather dense. Body length 3.5–4.6 mm. Head capsule subcircular (head length to mandibular base 1.0–1.20, maximum width 1.13–1.35 mm). Antennae 15–17-segmented. Postclypeus inflated, setose, less than half as long as wide (length 0.20–0.23, width 0.60–0.65 mm). Pronotum saddle-shaped (length 0.35–0.40, width 0.58–0.65 mm), anterior margin weakly to deeply concave, posterior margin nearly straight, sometimes weakly concave medially.
